title: 可数名词与数量表达
goal: 判断名词的可数用法；选择正确的数量表达和复数形式。

points.label: 选择正确的数量表达和复数形式

sources.title: 大学英语四级（CET-4）：课表
sources.used: 可数名词与数量表达的教学范围、知识点及写作小测规格

body.p: 名词是否可数，看它在英语语境中的用法，不按中文能否说几个来判断。advice 不可数；suggestion 指一项建议，可数。

body.box: The adviser offered useful advice, and the students wrote down several specific suggestions for their project.

body.p: 不可数名词不加复数词尾，前面不直接用 a 或数词。需要计数时用 a piece of advice。复数写 two pieces of advice，advice 不变。

cards.title: 词汇表：不可数用法
rows: advice
n. 建议；不可数，用 a piece of advice。
The counselor gave useful advice about choosing courses that matched the student's interests and experience.
information
n. 信息；不可数，用 a piece of information。
The notice provides information about the documents required for registration at the student service center.
equipment
n. 设备；不可数，用 a piece of equipment。
The photography group stores its equipment in a locked cabinet beside the main teaching studio.
furniture
n. 家具；集合性不可数，用 an item of furniture。
The common room needs some furniture that students can move easily during small group activities.
knowledge
n. 知识；泛指所知内容时不可数。
Practical knowledge helps new volunteers decide which questions they should refer to experienced staff members.
progress
n. 进展；不可数，常与 make 连用。
The group made steady progress after dividing the remaining work into clearly defined weekly tasks.
research
n. 研究；一般研究活动不可数。
The students conducted research into local transport choices before preparing their proposal for the community.
work
n. 工作；不可数。指作品时可数，如 works of art。
The team shared the remaining work so that every member could contribute before the deadline.

cards.title: 词汇表：可数与多义用法
rows: experience
n. 经验不可数；一次经历可数。

Nora gained experience by helping at the college welcome desk during the first week of term.
The visit was an unusual experience for students who had never entered a recording studio.
opportunity
n. 机会；可数，复数 opportunities。
The exchange offers several opportunities for students to discuss their plans with visitors from other departments.
suggestion
n. 一项建议；可数。
The class representative collected practical suggestions about improving access to the building during evening activities.
idea
n. 想法；可数，复数 ideas。
The planning group compared several ideas before choosing a theme for the annual student exhibition.
activity
n. 一项活动；可数，复数 activities。
Outdoor activities give students opportunities to work with classmates they rarely meet during ordinary lessons.
difficulty
n. 具体的困难可数；have difficulty doing 表示做某事费力，不可数。

The group identified two difficulties that could delay the installation of the new noticeboard.
Some participants had difficulty understanding the form because several instructions used unfamiliar technical terms.
problem
n. 问题；可数。
The students discussed several problems that appeared when they tested the first version of their design.
student
n. 学生；可数。
The visiting students joined a discussion about the services available during their first month on campus.

cards.title: 复数与数量表达
rows: -s
可数名词复数一般加 s。不可数名词不加。
The team received three suggestions and two ideas after presenting its initial plan to classmates.
-es
以 s、sh、ch、x 等结尾通常加 es。
Two classes shared the activity room while volunteers carried the storage boxes into the corridor.
辅音字母 + y
变 y 为 ies；元音字母 + y 通常直接加 s。
The societies arranged several activities, while survey responses described different ways of attracting new members.
many / much
many 接可数复数；much 接不可数。
The group received many suggestions but did not receive much information about the available budget.
few / little
few 接可数复数；little 接不可数，强调少。
Few students had seen the instructions, so the group had little knowledge of the procedure.
a few / a little
a few 接可数复数，a little 接不可数，表示还有一些。
A few volunteers brought materials, and a little advice helped them organize the first session.
量词
数词加在 piece、item 上，后面的不可数名词不变。
The technician checked three pieces of equipment and labeled each one before the workshop began.
按词义判断
experience 指积累的经验时不可数；指具体经历时可数。
She has much experience of organizing events and can describe several memorable experiences from that work.

body.box: A student reports on helping at an orientation desk. Draft: The work gave me many experiences in answering routine questions. Intended meaning: The student gained practical skill through repeated work, rather than describing several separate memorable events. The paragraph also mentions two useful pieces of advice from the desk supervisor.

body.p: 这里要说的是积累的经验，experience 不可数。many experiences 的意思是多次具体经历。按原意应改为 practical experience。

body.box: The work gave me practical experience in answering routine questions from newly enrolled students.

body.p: two pieces of advice 中，two 修饰 pieces，advice 不加 -s。改用可数的 suggestion 时，写 two suggestions。

items.stem: In 'The placement gave the student experience in organizing events', what does 'experience' mean?
options: Accumulated practical knowledge, used as an uncountable noun
Several separate occasions, used as a plural countable noun
One memorable event, requiring an indefinite article
A number of activities, each requiring a plural ending
items.why: experience in organizing events 指组织活动积累的经验，不可数，即第一项。

items.stem: Which pair fits: There were ___ opportunities, but ___ information about funding was available?
items.why: opportunities 是可数复数，用 many。information 不可数，用 little，即第二项。

items.stem: Which sentence uses 'difficulty' to mean specific obstacles that can be counted?
options: The group had difficulty finding a suitable place for its first meeting.
Finding a suitable meeting place caused difficulty for the group organizers.
The group faced two difficulties: choosing a location and agreeing on a time.
The group had considerable difficulty agreeing on a time for its meeting.
items.why: two difficulties 后面列出两项具体障碍，可数，即第三项。

items.stem: Use the plural of 'activity': The society plans three outdoor ___ for the coming term.
items.why: activity 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数变为 activities。

groups.text: A group is preparing a display about accessible campus facilities. Its members have collected information from visitors and received advice from a building manager. They have several suggestions but little experience of arranging a public display. Before opening, they must check the equipment and solve two problems with the signs.

items.stem: Which pair contains nouns used uncountably in this paragraph?
items.why: advice 和 equipment 在段中都不可数，即第四项。

items.stem: Express the need to check three separate units of equipment.
items.why: three 修饰 pieces。equipment 不可数，不写 equipments。

items.stem: Use only 'much' or 'many': The members do not have ___ experience of arranging displays.
items.why: experience 在这里指积累的经验，不可数，用 much。

groups.text: A student team is designing a tactile campus map. Members collect information about paths and entrances. A technician gives advice about durable materials. The students already have several ideas, but they have little experience of making raised labels. They plan to test the design and record any problems before producing the final map.

items.stem: Which pair contains only nouns used uncountably here?
items.why: information 和 advice 在段中都不可数，即第一项。

items.stem: Choose the correct pair: The team has ___ ideas but does not have ___ experience.
items.why: ideas 是可数复数，用 many。experience 指经验，不可数，用 much，即第二项。

items.stem: State what the technician supplied, using the given quantity.
items.why: two 修饰 pieces。advice 不可数，不写 advices。

items.stem: Use 'experience' or 'experiences' to mean accumulated practical knowledge: Making raised labels requires practical ___.
items.why: 题干说明指 accumulated practical knowledge，即不可数的经验，填 experience。

groups.text: A campus storytelling circle asks members to describe memorable experiences from part-time jobs. One student recalls two separate events at a ticket desk. Another offers suggestions for interviewing guests. The circle provides opportunities to practice speaking, while its organizers check the furniture and equipment needed for the next meeting.

items.stem: How is 'experiences' used in this paragraph?
options: As an uncountable term for all accumulated professional knowledge
As an incorrect plural that must always be replaced by experience
As a countable noun referring to separate events remembered by members
As a countable noun naming the part-time jobs that members once held
items.why: 依据是 recalls two separate events。experiences 指一件件记得的具体经历，可数，即第三项。

items.stem: Which phrase correctly counts the speaking opportunities mentioned in the paragraph?
options: three pieces of opportunity to practice speaking
items.why: opportunity 可数，以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数是 opportunities，即第四项。

items.stem: Describe the need to add one unit of furniture.
items.why: furniture 不可数，用 item 计数，不写 furnitures。

items.stem: Use 'work' or 'works' for employment duties rather than artistic creations: The student described the routine ___ at the ticket desk.
items.why: 题干说明指 employment duties，即工作，不可数，填 work。works 指作品。
